root_cause: The delayed listener raced a long press against an immediate Draggable (fixed earlier); the drop index came from the row under the pointer (fixed in the residual pass). Remaining: the reorder was a DragTarget drop applied at release, with no proxy for the dragged row, no gap animation and no drop animation, so onReorder fired at release instead of after Flutter's 250 ms drop.
change: Frame-order pass: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_lists.rs (reorderable part only): the list owns the reorder as Flutter's SliverReorderableListState does. ReorderDrag holds _DragInfo/_dragIndex/_insertIndex/_finalDropPosition, per-item GapOffset (updateForGap, 250 ms Curves.easeInOut, interruptible) and the proxy controller (_proxyAnimation, forward at start, reversed at release, Curves.easeOut drop lerp). The index rule (_dragUpdateItems) now runs on every drag update with gap-target geometry; release computes the drop slot (_dragEnd) and reports onReorderEnd(insertIndex); the render sliver's tick (pre-layout) completes the drop and reports onReorder/onReorderItem (_dropCompleted) then resets. The dragged row is laid out as the proxy (Floating placement, painted last) and the others at slot + gap. DragTarget wrappers and drop indices removed; cancel resets (_dragCancel). scrolling.rs: unused DragTarget import removed.
tests: reorderable.rs: 4 existing tests now settle frames before asserting onReorder (Flutter reports it after the drop animation)
harness: gestures__reorderable_list_long_press: match (was diverging: no proxy, no gap, ended_index)
api_change: Behavior: onReorder/onReorderItem and the controller move now happen when the drop animation lands (250 ms x proxy value after release), not at release. onReorderEnd still fires at release.
limitations: The proxy stays inside the sliver viewport (clipped by it) instead of a root Overlay; no proxyDecorator, auto-scroll or drag boundary; reversed lists use the content-space mirror of Flutter's reverse rules; drag state lives on the render sliver, so a parent rebuild mid-drag restarts it.

root_cause: Widget arenas had no sole-member default. A drag member stayed pending until its own slop test, and the slop-crossing movement was dropped under DragStartBehavior.start. Flutter closes the arena after the hit test, and a sole member wins by default (arena.dart:251-276), starting its drag at the press. Residual pass: the remaining harness divergence was not the slop. Dismissible measured progress against the incoming max constraint (800 under Center) instead of its own laid-out size (Flutter _overallDragAxisExtent = context.size, 160), so 100 px gave 0.125. During the resize Flutter also replaces the child with an empty SizedBox of _sizePriorToCollapse, so the child leaves the tree.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: accept_sole_press called from the press path when the stream has exactly one member and it is not yields_taps; crates/incular-gestures/src/pointer.rs: can_accept_on_press, accept_on_press, accepted_on_press (first movement reports in full), begin_drag helper. Residual pass: crates/incular-widgets/src/dismissible.rs: a size observer records the laid-out extent (the constraint stands in before the first layout) and the size before collapse; the resize phase builds SizedBox(prior size) instead of the child. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: a scroll stream with ancestor scrollables (nested) is no longer pre-accepted at the press, since each Flutter Scrollable is its own arena member.
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/dismissible.rs (slow_drag helper moves the child by extent in total; expectations unchanged)
crates/incular-widgets/tests/scroll_viewport_lists.rs (expectations moved to Flutter sole-member semantics; see note)
harness: gestures__dismissible_threshold: match (residual pass; was progress 0.125 vs 0.625, then present true vs false). sample_list_fling: match. gestures__draggable_drop_target: match.
limitations: Pre-acceptance applies only at the press with one member. When a later rejection leaves one pending member (Flutter resolves it on a microtask), Incular still waits for that member's own slop. Tap, long-press, double-tap and delayed members are not pre-accepted. Residual: before the first layout the constraint stands in for the extent.
note: Three dismissible expectations encoded the dropped first move; the helper now produces the total displacement Flutter would report. Residual pass, scroll_viewport_lists regression (39 failures, now 97/97): 36 drag and fling tests encoded slop-crossing acceptance for a lone Scrollable. In Flutter 3.41.7 a lone Scrollable is the sole arena member and wins at the press (gestures/arena.dart _tryToResolveArena -> _resolveByDefault; gestures/monodrag.dart acceptGesture -> _checkDrag), so Start fires at the press, every move updates (the first included), a tap brackets Start and End, and a clamped outward move reports Overscroll. Expectations updated with citations; sample_list_fling confirms. The nested-scroll tests failed because pre-acceptance also applied to nested scroll streams; fixed in code (see change). viewport_resize_during_drag_re_ranges_coherently now starts at 38 so the drag stays in range: from 100 (at the max), the viewport shrink moved the offset to the new max 140, where Flutter RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics would clamp; reported, not investigated (scroll worker area). Cache-extent tests: 16 -> 15 rows, because row 15 starts exactly at the 600 px cache edge and Flutter rendering/sliver_list.dart stops at endScrollOffset >= targetEndScrollOffset (slivers-006 edge rule, correct). cross_tree_duplicate_attachment_is_rejected: jump_to now brackets Start and End as Flutter jumpTo does (scroll worker change); expectation updated.

root_cause: The recognizer deadline poll returned only LongPressStart; onLongPress was dispatched from the pointer-up branch. Flutter calls onLongPressStart then onLongPress from _checkLongPressStart when the deadline fires (long_press.dart:737-748).
change: crates/incular-gestures/src/pointer.rs: dispatch(LongPressStart) also calls on_long_press; a movement-driven deadline returns Accept(LongPressStart) instead of an inline callback; release after a deadline report returns Pending instead of re-reporting LongPress.
limitations: Consumers that never poll still get onLongPress at release through the fallback path, as before.
note: Two existing tests asserted the old release-time onLongPress and were updated to Flutter behavior.

root_cause: The first tap was recorded only in the tap-up branch, which requires onTap, onTapUp or onTapCancel. The recognizer is rebuilt for every press, so the first-tap record also could not survive to the second press.
change: crates/incular-gestures/src/pointer.rs: the first tap is recorded when onDoubleTap is present without tap callbacks; TapMemory and set_tap_memory share the record across presses; crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: the recognizer gets the element's shared memory when onDoubleTap is set; crates/incular-widgets/src/tree.rs InputState gains tap_memories (out-of-list edit, one field).
api_change: additive pub TapMemory type re-exported from incular-gestures
limitations: onTap plus onDoubleTap across presses now uses the same memory but was not separately tested.

root_cause: LongPressDraggable::from built a plain Draggable with no delay, so a quick move started a drag immediately. Flutter LongPressDraggable uses DelayedMultiDragGestureRecognizer with kLongPressTimeout (drag_target.dart:404-445).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/drag_drop.rs: LongPressDraggable wraps a Draggable with start_delay(LONG_PRESS_TIMEOUT) and forwards the common builders (feedback, child_when_dragging, feedback_offset, max_simultaneous_drags, on_start, on_end, on_cancel, on_drag_end, on_drag_completed, on_draggable_canceled).
api_change: additive: LongPressDraggable gains builder methods; new() signature unchanged; the type now wraps a Draggable
limitations: No widget-level test for LongPressDraggable; the held-long-enough path (drag starts at 500 ms) was not run.

root_cause: A scale member waited for arena acceptance after movement past slop, so onStart came one move late and the pinch span was measured at acceptance. Flutter accepts a sole scale at the press (scale.dart acceptGesture starts it and measures from current contacts). Residual pass: the press-time acceptance dispatched the update returned by accept_scale, so onScaleUpdate fired at the press (focal 300, pointers 1). Flutter acceptGesture reports only onStart; updates come with movement. The second contact reconfigures the initial span (scale.dart _reconfigure), which the arithmetic already did.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: accept_sole_press accepts a sole scale member at the press and dispatches its start through accept_scale; crates/incular-gestures/src/scale.rs unchanged (accept() already measures the initial span from current contacts). Residual pass: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs accept_sole_press no longer dispatches a scale update at the press.
tests: no new recognizer test; existing crates/incular-gestures/tests/scale_slop.rs passes

crates/incular-widgets/tests/tree_editing_semantics_gestures.rs::gesture_region_combines_identified_contacts_for_scale_updates (updated: scale 2.0, 4.8, 7.2 against the span 5 set when the second contact reconfigures, as Flutter; the old 0, 1, 1.5 encoded slop acceptance)
limitations: The two-pointer case is only partly covered: a sole member is accepted at the first press, and the second contact reconfigures the span. Whether the pinch values match Flutter (1.5 at 48 ms) is unverified.
